title: Catch up tomorrow
summary: As their tea break ends, Fattoush and Knafeh turn a vague tomorrow into a shared plan.

scenes.title: Before the break ends
scenes.situation: Their rest and tea have made room for a short conversation. Before ending the catch-up, Fattoush asks about tomorrow. Knafeh suggests a visit after work.

text.meaning: Shall we visit my family after work?

scenes.title: A missing time
scenes.situation: The idea sounds good, but after work does not give a clock time. Fattoush asks for the detail they still need.

scenes.title: The same plan
scenes.situation: Fattoush confirms the day, time and whose family they will visit. Knafeh adds tea together afterwards, giving them another chance to catch up.

text.arabic: تمام، بكرا الساعة ستة نزور أهلك.
text.arabizi: Tamām, bukra is-sāʿa sitte nzūr ahlak.
text.meaning: Okay, tomorrow at six we’ll visit your family. (to Knafeh)
And afterwards we’ll drink tea together.

checks.prompt: Whose family do they plan to visit tomorrow?

choices.rationale: Knafeh says my family. When Fattoush confirms to him, she says your family.
Knafeh proposes visiting his own family; Fattoush confirms that same family from her perspective.

choices.text: Neither family; they only plan tea.
choices.rationale: Tea comes afterwards. The family visit is part of the agreed plan.

checks.explanation: Ahli is my family when Knafeh speaks. Ahlak in Fattoush’s confirmation refers back to his family.

checks.prompt: When do they agree to visit?

choices.rationale: Knafeh suggests after work and gives six; Fattoush confirms tomorrow at six.
Six is correct, but bukra places the plan tomorrow rather than today.
Tomorrow is correct, but the scene agrees on six, not seven.

checks.explanation: The final confirmation brings together tomorrow, six o’clock and the family visit after work.

checks.prompt: Reply as Fattoush: confirm tomorrow at six and the visit to Knafeh’s family.

choices.rationale: This asks what to do tomorrow instead of confirming the arrangement already made.
This gives seven rather than six and leaves out the day and family visit.

choices.text: تمام، بكرا الساعة ستة نزور أهلك.
choices.help: Tamām, bukra is-sāʿa sitte nzūr ahlak.
choices.meaning: Okay, tomorrow at six we’ll visit your family. (to Knafeh)
choices.rationale: This preserves all three requested details: tomorrow, six and Knafeh’s family.

checks.explanation: The confirmation keeps the day and time and uses your family when Fattoush addresses Knafeh. This is assisted written practice.
